title: Welcome Back Parish Picnic
summary: Burgers, games and a bouncy castle on the front lawn after the 11:00 AM Mass. Everyone is welcome — bring a lawn chair.

title: Alpha — Session 1: Is There More to Life Than This?
summary: A free ten-week series exploring the basics of the Christian faith over a shared meal. No question is off limits.

title: Baptism Preparation Class
summary: Required for parents and godparents before an infant baptism. Register through the parish office.

title: First Friday Adoration & Benediction
summary: Exposition of the Blessed Sacrament with confessions available, ending with Benediction.

title: Blessing of Animals — Feast of St. Francis
summary: Bring your pets (on a leash or in a carrier) to the front steps after the 9:00 AM Mass for a blessing.

title: Thanksgiving Food Drive Collection
summary: Non-perishable food for our St. Vincent de Paul pantry. Drop-off in the narthex after all Masses this weekend.

title: Knights of Columbus Charity Dinner & Dance
summary: Annual fundraising dinner supporting the parish food pantry and Special Olympics. Tickets $60 at the parish office.

title: Confirmation Parent Information Session
summary: For parents of Grade 7 students preparing for Confirmation in spring 2027.

title: Volunteer Screening Workshop
summary: Archdiocesan Safe Environment training for all new volunteers in high-risk ministries.

title: All Saints’ Day Mass
summary: Holy day of obligation. Masses at 8:30 AM, 11:00 AM and 7:00 PM.

title: All Souls’ Day Memorial Mass
summary: We remember all parishioners who died this past year. Families of the deceased are especially invited; names will be read.

title: CWL Christmas Bazaar & Bake Sale
summary: Hand-made crafts, preserves, baking and a tea room hosted by the Catholic Women’s League.

title: Youth Ministry: Praise & Worship Night
summary: An evening of music, adoration and pizza for Grades 9–12. Friends welcome.

title: Advent Wreath Blessing & Lessons and Carols
summary: Begin Advent with the blessing of family wreaths and carols by the parish choir.

title: Immaculate Conception Mass
summary: Solemnity of the Immaculate Conception of the Blessed Virgin Mary.

title: Advent Penitential Service
summary: Several priests available for confession before Christmas.

title: Christmas Eve Family Mass
summary: Children’s pageant at 3:30 PM, Mass at 4:00 PM. Also 8:00 PM and Midnight Mass (carols at 11:30 PM).

title: Rosary & Novena to Our Lady of Perpetual Help
